T1D_stage_definitions.review: Stage definitions reviewed by islet expert

Stage 1.definition: Two or more positive islet autoantibodies with normal glucose metabolism
Stage 1.key_rules: AAB >= 2; glucose normal; no clinical symptoms

Stage 2.definition: Two or more positive islet autoantibodies with dysglycemia
Stage 2.key_rules: AAB >= 2; dysglycemia present; no clinical symptoms

Stage 3.definition: Clinical T1D diagnosis and/or diagnostic hyperglycemia
Stage 3.key_rules: T1D diagnosis or diagnostic hyperglycemia is sufficient evidence
Stage 3.aab_note: Positive AAB supports autoimmune T1D; negative or missing AAB should be flagged but does not override Stage 3 when diagnosis/hyperglycemia is present

recorded_metadata_guardrails.classification_scope: Recorded stage, diagnosis category and derived status describe different classifications. Different labels do not alone establish a contradiction.
recorded_metadata_guardrails.stage_1_and_2: Do not call Stage 1 or Stage 2 alongside Control Without Diabetes, Normal or Prediabetes a metadata conflict solely on those labels. Preserve each recorded field; do not add a diagnosed-T1D restriction to a stage-based cohort.
recorded_metadata_guardrails.clinical_limit: Report source metadata without making a new diagnosis or claiming external clinical guideline verification.
